newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EMERSON RETURNS TO FACE MIDDLESBROUGH WRATH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EMERSON RETURNS TO FACE MIDDLESBROUGH WRATH.

text.p: Middlesbrough's troubled Brazilian midfielder Emerson returned to England on Saturday, 72 hours late, to face the wrath of manager Bryan Robson over his unauthorised absence.

Emerson, who signed for the northern English club in the summer for four million pounds sterling ($6.4 million) but is reported to be unhappy there, arrived at London's Heathrow Airport without his wife Andrea, who stayed behind in Brazil. The player made no comment to waiting journalists but earlier he told Britain's Sun newspaper : "My wife has found it impossible to settle in at Middlesbrough.

"She has problems with the food, the language and loneliness whenever I've been travelling," added Emerson, who had been reported as saying in Brazil that he wanted to negotiate his release from the premier league club.

Middlesbrough chairman Steve Gibson had threatened to impose a hefty fine on Emerson and ask FIFA to ban him worldwide if he continued to defy the club by refusing to return and honour his four-year contract. Emerson was expected to join the Middlesbrough squad in Derby, ahead of Sunday's premier league match. He is ineligible to play against Derby because of a three-match suspension.
